using Volo.Abp.AutoMapper;
using Volo.Abp.Modularity;
using Volo.Abp.Application;
using Volo.Abp.Identity;

namespace CRM;

[DependsOn(
    typeof(CRM.Application.Contracts.CRMApplicationContractsModule),
    typeof(CRMDomainModule),
    typeof(AbpDddApplicationModule),
    typeof(AbpAutoMapperModule),
    typeof(AbpIdentityDomainModule)
)]
public class CRMApplicationModule : AbpModule
{
    public override void ConfigureServices(ServiceConfigurationContext context)
    {
        Configure<AbpAutoMapperOptions>(options =>
        {
            options.AddMaps<CRMApplicationModule>();
        });
    }
}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Application\Leads\LeadAppService.cs

using CRM.CustomerTypes;
using CRM.LeadSources;
using CRM.LeadStages;
using CRM.Services;
using CsvHelper;
using CsvHelper.Configuration;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp;
using Volo.Abp.Application.Dtos;
using Volo.Abp.Application.Services;
using Volo.Abp.Domain.Repositories;
using Volo.Abp.Identity;

namespace CRM.Leads;

public class LeadAppService : CrudAppService<
    Lead,
    LeadDto,
    Guid,
    PagedAndSortedResultRequestDto,
    CreateUpdateLeadDto>, ILeadAppService
{
    private readonly IRepository<CustomerType, Guid> _customerTypeRepository;
    private readonly IRepository<LeadSource, Guid> _leadSourceRepository;
    private readonly IRepository<LeadStage, Guid> _leadStageRepository;
    private readonly IRepository<Service, Guid> _serviceRepository;
    private readonly IRepository<IdentityUser, Guid> _userRepository; // Change here

    public LeadAppService(
        IRepository<Lead, Guid> repository,
        IRepository<CustomerType, Guid> customerTypeRepository,
        IRepository<LeadSource, Guid> leadSourceRepository,
        IRepository<LeadStage, Guid> leadStageRepository,
        IRepository<Service, Guid> serviceRepository,
        IRepository<IdentityUser, Guid> userRepository) : base(repository) // Change here
    {
        _customerTypeRepository = customerTypeRepository;
        _leadSourceRepository = leadSourceRepository;
        _leadStageRepository = leadStageRepository;
        _serviceRepository = serviceRepository;
        _userRepository = userRepository;
    }

    public override async Task<PagedResultDto<LeadDto>> GetListAsync(PagedAndSortedResultRequestDto input)
    {
        // 1. Fetch CRM Queryables (from CRMDbContext)
        var query = await Repository.GetQueryableAsync();
        var ctQuery = await _customerTypeRepository.GetQueryableAsync();
        var lsQuery = await _leadSourceRepository.GetQueryableAsync();
        var stQuery = await _leadStageRepository.GetQueryableAsync();
        var sQuery = await _serviceRepository.GetQueryableAsync();

        // 2. Join CRM entities in SQL
        var baseQuery = from lead in query
                        join ct in ctQuery on lead.CustomerTypeId equals ct.Id
                        join ls in lsQuery on lead.LeadSourceId equals ls.Id
                        join st in stQuery on lead.LeadStageId equals st.Id
                        join s in sQuery on lead.ServiceId equals s.Id
                        select new
                        {
                            lead,
                            CustomerTypeName = ct.Name,
                            LeadSourceName = ls.Name,
                            LeadStageName = st.Name,
                            ServiceName = s.Name
                        };

        // 3. Get total count and paged items from database
        var totalCount = await baseQuery.CountAsync();
        var items = await baseQuery
            .Skip(input.SkipCount)
            .Take(input.MaxResultCount)
            .ToListAsync();

        // 4. Fetch assigned User IDs from the current page
        var userIds = items
            .Where(x => x.lead.AssignedUserId.HasValue)
            .Select(x => x.lead.AssignedUserId.Value)
            .Distinct()
            .ToList();

        // 5. Query IdentityUsers separately (from IIdentityDbContext)
        var userDictionary = new Dictionary<Guid, string>();
        if (userIds.Any())
        {
            var usersQuery = await _userRepository.GetQueryableAsync();
            userDictionary = await usersQuery
                .Where(u => userIds.Contains(u.Id))
                .ToDictionaryAsync(u => u.Id, u => u.UserName);
        }

        // 6. Map and attach AssignedUserName in-memory
        var dtos = items.Select(x =>
        {
            var dto = ObjectMapper.Map<Lead, LeadDto>(x.lead);
            dto.CustomerTypeName = x.CustomerTypeName;
            dto.LeadSourceName = x.LeadSourceName;
            dto.LeadStageName = x.LeadStageName;
            dto.ServiceName = x.ServiceName;

            dto.AssignedUserName = x.lead.AssignedUserId.HasValue && userDictionary.TryGetValue(x.lead.AssignedUserId.Value, out var userName)
                ? userName
                : "Unassigned";

            return dto;
        }).ToList();

        return new PagedResultDto<LeadDto>(totalCount, dtos);
    }



    // Import CSV File
    public virtual async Task<int> ImportCsvAsync(string csvContent)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(csvContent)) return 0;

        using var stringReader = new StringReader(csvContent);
        using var csv = new CsvReader(stringReader, new CsvConfiguration(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        {
            HeaderValidated = null,
            MissingFieldFound = null,
            PrepareHeaderForMatch = args => args.Header.Trim().ToLower()
        });

        var records = csv.GetRecords<LeadCsvRecordDto>().ToList();
        if (!records.Any()) return 0;

        // Fetch database items as a list first, then group by key to safely prevent duplicate key errors
        var customerTypesList = await (await _customerTypeRepository.GetQueryableAsync()).ToListAsync();
        var customerTypes = customerTypesList
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Name))
            .GroupBy(x => x.Name.Trim().ToLower())
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().Id);

        var leadSourcesList = await (await _leadSourceRepository.GetQueryableAsync()).ToListAsync();
        var leadSources = leadSourcesList
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Name))
            .GroupBy(x => x.Name.Trim().ToLower())
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().Id);

        var leadStagesList = await (await _leadStageRepository.GetQueryableAsync()).ToListAsync();
        var leadStages = leadStagesList
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Name))
            .GroupBy(x => x.Name.Trim().ToLower())
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().Id);

        var servicesList = await (await _serviceRepository.GetQueryableAsync()).ToListAsync();
        var services = servicesList
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Name))
            .GroupBy(x => x.Name.Trim().ToLower())
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().Id);

        var usersList = await (await _userRepository.GetQueryableAsync()).ToListAsync();
        var users = usersList
            .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.UserName))
            .GroupBy(x => x.UserName.Trim().ToLower())
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().Id);




        var leadsToInsert = new List<Lead>();
        var errors = new List<string>();
        var rowNumber = 1; // header

        foreach (var row in records)
        {
            rowNumber++;
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.Name)) continue;

            var ctOk = customerTypes.TryGetValue(row.CustomerTypeName?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "", out var ctId);
            var lsOk = leadSources.TryGetValue(row.LeadSourceName?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "", out var lsId);
            var stOk = leadStages.TryGetValue(row.LeadStageName?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "", out var stId);
            var sOk = services.TryGetValue(row.ServiceName?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "", out var sId);

            var rowErrors = new List<string>();
            if (!ctOk) rowErrors.Add($"CustomerType '{row.CustomerTypeName}' not found");
            if (!lsOk) rowErrors.Add($"LeadSource '{row.LeadSourceName}' not found");
            if (!stOk) rowErrors.Add($"LeadStage '{row.LeadStageName}' not found");
            if (!sOk) rowErrors.Add($"Service '{row.ServiceName}' not found");
            if (row.Name.Trim().Length > 128) rowErrors.Add("Name > 128 chars");
            if ((row.CompanyName?.Length ?? 0) > 128) rowErrors.Add("CompanyName > 128 chars");
            if ((row.Email?.Length ?? 0) > 256) rowErrors.Add("Email > 256 chars");
            if ((row.Phone?.Length ?? 0) > 32) rowErrors.Add("Phone > 32 chars");
            if ((row.Remarks?.Length ?? 0) > 1000) rowErrors.Add("Remarks > 1000 chars");

            if (rowErrors.Any())
            {
                errors.Add($"Row {rowNumber}: {string.Join("; ", rowErrors)}");
                continue;
            }

            Guid? assignedUserId = null;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.AssignedUserName) &&
                users.TryGetValue(row.AssignedUserName.Trim().ToLower(), out var uId))
            {
                assignedUserId = uId;
            }

            leadsToInsert.Add(new Lead(
                GuidGenerator.Create(), row.Name.Trim(), ctId, lsId, stId, sId,
                row.CompanyName ?? string.Empty, row.Email ?? string.Empty,
                row.Phone ?? string.Empty, row.EstimatedBudget ?? 0m,
                row.Remarks, assignedUserId));
        }

        if (errors.Any())
        {
            throw new UserFriendlyException(
                "CSV import failed. " + string.Join(" | ", errors.Take(10)) +
                (errors.Count > 10 ? $" ... and {errors.Count - 10} more" : ""));
        }

        if (leadsToInsert.Any())
        {
            // autoSave: true runs SaveChanges now, inside the page's try/catch
            await Repository.InsertManyAsync(leadsToInsert, autoSave: true);
        }

        return leadsToInsert.Count;
    }

}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Application\Messenger\MessengerAppService.cs
=====================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Volo.Abp;
using Volo.Abp.Application.Services;
using Volo.Abp.Domain.Entities;
using Volo.Abp.Domain.Repositories;

namespace CRM.Messenger;

[Authorize]
public class MessengerAppService : ApplicationService, IMessengerAppService
{
    private readonly IRepository<MessengerConversation, Guid> _conversations;
    private readonly IRepository<MessengerMessage, Guid> _messages;
    private readonly MessengerGraphClient _graph;
    private readonly MessengerFileStore _files;
    private readonly MessengerConnectionService _connections;

    public MessengerAppService(
        IRepository<MessengerConversation, Guid> conversations,
        IRepository<MessengerMessage, Guid> messages,
        MessengerGraphClient graph,
        MessengerFileStore files,
        MessengerConnectionService connections)
    {
        _conversations = conversations;
        _messages = messages;
        _graph = graph;
        _files = files;
        _connections = connections;
    }

    // Tenant filter is ON everywhere: a tenant can only ever see its own data.

    public async Task<List<MessengerConversationDto>> GetConversationsAsync()
    {
        var q = await _conversations.GetQueryableAsync();
        return await q.OrderByDescending(x => x.LastMessageTime)
            .Take(100)
            .Select(x => new MessengerConversationDto
            {
                Id = x.Id,
                CustomerName = x.CustomerName,
                ProfilePictureUrl = x.ProfilePictureUrl,
                LastMessageText = x.LastMessageText,
                LastMessageTime = x.LastMessageTime,
                UnreadCount = x.UnreadCount
            }).ToListAsync();
    }

    public async Task<List<MessengerMessageDto>> GetMessagesAsync(Guid conversationId)
    {
        var q = await _messages.GetQueryableAsync();
        var list = await q.Where(x => x.ConversationId == conversationId)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.SentTime).Take(200).ToListAsync();
        list.Reverse();
        return list.Select(ToDto).ToList();
    }

    public async Task<MessengerMessageDto> SendAsync(Guid conversationId, SendMessengerMessageInput input)
    {
        var conv = await _conversations.GetAsync(conversationId);
        var text = input.Text.Trim();

        var token = await _connections.GetTokenAsync(conv.PageId);
        var mid = await _graph.SendTextAsync(token, conv.PageScopedUserId, text);

        var msg = new MessengerMessage(GuidGenerator.Create(), conv.Id, mid, text, false,
            DateTime.UtcNow, CurrentUser.Id);
        await _messages.InsertAsync(msg);

        conv.LastMessageText = text.Length > 200 ? text[..200] : text;
        conv.LastMessageTime = msg.SentTime;
        await _conversations.UpdateAsync(conv, autoSave: true);

        return ToDto(msg);
    }

    public async Task<MessengerMessageDto> SendFileAsync(
        Guid conversationId, string fileName, string contentType, byte[] content)
    {
        if (content == null || content.Length == 0)
            throw new UserFriendlyException("The file is empty.");
        if (content.Length > MessengerGraphClient.MaxFileBytes)
            throw new UserFriendlyException("File is too large. Maximum size is 25 MB.");

        var conv = await _conversations.GetAsync(conversationId);

        var safeName = Path.GetFileName(fileName ?? "");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(safeName)) safeName = "file";
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(contentType)) contentType = "application/octet-stream";

        var type = MessengerMime.TypeFromMime(contentType);
        var token = await _connections.GetTokenAsync(conv.PageId);
        var mid = await _graph.SendAttachmentAsync(token, conv.PageScopedUserId, type, safeName, contentType, content);
        var stored = await _files.SaveAsync(content, safeName);

        var msg = new MessengerMessage(GuidGenerator.Create(), conv.Id,
            mid == null ? null : mid + ":0", "", false, DateTime.UtcNow, CurrentUser.Id)
        {
            AttachmentType = type,
            AttachmentName = safeName,
            AttachmentMimeType = contentType,
            AttachmentStoredName = stored,
            AttachmentSize = content.Length
        };
        await _messages.InsertAsync(msg);

        var preview = MessengerMime.Preview(type, safeName, null);
        conv.LastMessageText = preview.Length > 200 ? preview[..200] : preview;
        conv.LastMessageTime = msg.SentTime;
        await _conversations.UpdateAsync(conv, autoSave: true);

        return ToDto(msg);
    }

    public async Task<MessengerAttachmentDto> GetAttachmentAsync(Guid messageId)
    {
        var msg = await _messages.GetAsync(messageId);

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(msg.AttachmentStoredName))
            throw new EntityNotFoundException(typeof(MessengerMessage), messageId);

        var content = await _files.ReadAsync(msg.AttachmentStoredName);
        if (content == null)
            throw new EntityNotFoundException(typeof(MessengerMessage), messageId);

        return new MessengerAttachmentDto
        {
            FileName = msg.AttachmentName ?? "file",
            ContentType = msg.AttachmentMimeType ?? "application/octet-stream",
            Content = content
        };
    }

    public async Task MarkAsReadAsync(Guid conversationId)
    {
        var conv = await _conversations.GetAsync(conversationId);
        if (conv.UnreadCount == 0) return;
        conv.UnreadCount = 0;
        await _conversations.UpdateAsync(conv, autoSave: true);
    }

    public async Task<int> GetUnreadCountAsync()
    {
        var q = await _conversations.GetQueryableAsync();
        return await q.SumAsync(x => x.UnreadCount);
    }

    private static MessengerMessageDto ToDto(MessengerMessage m) => new()
    {
        Id = m.Id,
        Text = m.Text,
        IsFromCustomer = m.IsFromCustomer,
        SentTime = m.SentTime,
        AttachmentType = m.AttachmentType,
        AttachmentName = m.AttachmentName,
        AttachmentMimeType = m.AttachmentMimeType,
        AttachmentSize = m.AttachmentSize
    };
}


=====================================================
FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Application\Messenger\MessengerConnectionService.cs
=====================================================

using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Volo.Abp;
using Volo.Abp.Data;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;
using Volo.Abp.Domain.Repositories;
using Volo.Abp.Guids;
using Volo.Abp.MultiTenancy;
using Volo.Abp.Security.Encryption;

namespace CRM.Messenger;

public class MessengerConnectionInfo
{
    public Guid? TenantId { get; set; }
    public string PageId { get; set; } = default!;
    public string Token { get; set; } = default!;
}

public class MessengerConnectionService : ITransientDependency
{
    private readonly IRepository<MessengerPageConnection, Guid> _repo;
    private readonly IStringEncryptionService _crypto;
    private readonly MessengerGraphClient _graph;
    private readonly IGuidGenerator _guid;
    private readonly ICurrentTenant _tenant;
    private readonly IDataFilter _dataFilter;

    public MessengerConnectionService(
        IRepository<MessengerPageConnection, Guid> repo,
        IStringEncryptionService crypto,
        MessengerGraphClient graph,
        IGuidGenerator guid,
        ICurrentTenant tenant,
        IDataFilter dataFilter)
    {
        _repo = repo;
        _crypto = crypto;
        _graph = graph;
        _guid = guid;
        _tenant = tenant;
        _dataFilter = dataFilter;
    }

    // Used ONLY by the webhook (nobody is logged in there): find which tenant owns this page.
    public async Task<MessengerConnectionInfo?> FindByPageIdAsync(string pageId)
    {
        using (_dataFilter.Disable<IMultiTenant>())
        {
            var c = await _repo.FindAsync(x => x.PageId == pageId);
            if (c == null) return null;

            return new MessengerConnectionInfo
            {
                TenantId = c.TenantId,
                PageId = c.PageId,
                Token = _crypto.Decrypt(c.AccessToken)!
            };
        }
    }

    // Used when sending: current tenant's page token (tenant filter is automatic).
    public async Task<string> GetTokenAsync(string? pageId)
    {
        var q = await _repo.GetQueryableAsync();
        var c = string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageId)
            ? await q.FirstOrDefaultAsync()
            : await q.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.PageId == pageId);

        if (c == null)
        {
            throw new UserFriendlyException("Messenger is not connected. Open Messenger Settings and connect your page.");
        }

        return _crypto.Decrypt(c.AccessToken)!;
    }

    public async Task<MessengerPageConnection?> GetCurrentAsync()
    {
        var q = await _repo.GetQueryableAsync();
        return await q.FirstOrDefaultAsync();
    }

    public async Task ConnectAsync(string token)
    {
        token = (token ?? "").Trim();
        if (token.Length == 0) throw new UserFriendlyException("Please paste the Page Access Token.");

        var (pageId, name) = await _graph.GetPageAsync(token);

        // A page can belong to only one tenant
        using (_dataFilter.Disable<IMultiTenant>())
        {
            var other = await _repo.FindAsync(x => x.PageId == pageId);
            if (other != null && other.TenantId != _tenant.Id)
            {
                throw new UserFriendlyException("This page is already connected to another account.");
            }
        }

        await _graph.SubscribeAsync(pageId, token);

        var existing = await _repo.FindAsync(x => x.PageId == pageId);
        if (existing == null)
        {
            await _repo.InsertAsync(new MessengerPageConnection(
                _guid.Create(), _tenant.Id, pageId, name, _crypto.Encrypt(token)!));
        }
        else
        {
            existing.PageName = name;
            existing.AccessToken = _crypto.Encrypt(token)!;
            await _repo.UpdateAsync(existing);
        }
    }

    public async Task DisconnectAsync()
    {
        var c = await GetCurrentAsync();
        if (c != null) await _repo.DeleteAsync(c);
    }
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;

namespace CRM.Messenger;

public class MessengerFileStore : ITransientDependency
{
    private readonly string _root;

    public MessengerFileStore(IConfiguration config)
    {
        var configured = config["Messenger:FilesPath"];
        _root = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured)
            ? Path.Combine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), "App_Data", "messenger-files")
            : configured;
    }

    public async Task<string> SaveAsync(byte[] content, string fileName)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(_root);

        var ext = Path.GetExtension(fileName ?? "");
        if (ext.Length > 10 || !ext.All(c => char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '.')) ext = "";

        var stored = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ext.ToLowerInvariant();
        await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(Path.Combine(_root, stored), content);
        return stored;
    }

    public async Task<byte[]?> ReadAsync(string storedName)
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(_root, Path.GetFileName(storedName));
        return File.Exists(path) ? await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(path) : null;
    }
}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Application\Messenger\MessengerGraphClient.cs
=====================================================

using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Volo.Abp;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;

namespace CRM.Messenger;

public class MessengerGraphClient : ITransientDependency
{
    public const int MaxFileBytes = 25 * 1024 * 1024;

    private static readonly HttpClient Http = new();
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;

    public MessengerGraphClient(IConfiguration config) => _config = config;

    private string Version => _config["Messenger:GraphApiVersion"] ?? "v21.0";

    private static HttpRequestMessage NewRequest(HttpMethod method, string url, string token)
    {
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(method, url);
        req.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        return req;
    }

    // Checks the token and returns the page it belongs to
    
    public async Task<(string Id, string Name)> GetPageAsync(string token)
    {
        var req = NewRequest(HttpMethod.Get, $"https://graph.facebook.com/{Version}/me?fields=id,name", token);
        var res = await Http.SendAsync(req);
        var json = await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);

        if (!res.IsSuccessStatusCode || !doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("id", out var id))
        {
            throw new UserFriendlyException("Facebook says: " + ReadError(doc.RootElement));
        }

        var name = doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("name", out var n) ? n.GetString() : null;
        return (id.GetString()!, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) ? "Facebook Page" : name!);
    }

    // Tells Facebook to send this page's messages to our webhook
    public async Task SubscribeAsync(string pageId, string token)
    {
        var req = NewRequest(HttpMethod.Post,
            $"https://graph.facebook.com/{Version}/{pageId}/subscribed_apps?subscribed_fields=messages,message_echoes",
            token);
        var res = await Http.SendAsync(req);

        if (!res.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
            throw new UserFriendlyException("Facebook says: " + ReadError(doc.RootElement));
        }
    }

    private static string ReadError(JsonElement root)
    {
        if (root.TryGetProperty("error", out var e) && e.TryGetProperty("message", out var m))
        {
            var code = e.TryGetProperty("code", out var c) ? c.ToString() : "";
            return $"{m.GetString()} (code {code})";
        }
        return "Unknown error.";
    }

    public async Task<(string Name, string? Picture)> GetProfileAsync(string psid, string token)
    {
        try
        {
            var req = NewRequest(HttpMethod.Get,
                $"https://graph.facebook.com/{Version}/{psid}?fields=first_name,last_name,profile_pic", token);
            var res = await Http.SendAsync(req);
            if (!res.IsSuccessStatusCode) return ("Facebook User", null);

            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
            var r = doc.RootElement;
            var first = r.TryGetProperty("first_name", out var f) ? f.GetString() : "";
            var last = r.TryGetProperty("last_name", out var l) ? l.GetString() : "";
            var pic = r.TryGetProperty("profile_pic", out var p) ? p.GetString() : null;
            var name = $"{first} {last}".Trim();
            return (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) ? "Facebook User" : name, pic);
        }
        catch
        {
            return ("Facebook User", null);
        }
    }

    public async Task<string?> SendTextAsync(string token, string psid, string text)
    {
        var body = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            recipient = new { id = psid },
            messaging_type = "RESPONSE",
            message = new { text }
        });

        var req = NewRequest(HttpMethod.Post, $"https://graph.facebook.com/{Version}/me/messages", token);
        req.Content = new StringContent(body, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

        return await SendAndReadMessageIdAsync(req);
    }

    public async Task<string?> SendAttachmentAsync(
        string token, string psid, string type, string fileName, string contentType, byte[] content)
    {
        using var form = new MultipartFormDataContent();
        form.Add(new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { id = psid })), "recipient");
        form.Add(new StringContent("RESPONSE"), "messaging_type");
        form.Add(new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            attachment = new { type, payload = new { is_reusable = true } }
        })), "message");

        var file = new ByteArrayContent(content);
        file.Headers.ContentType = MediaTypeHeaderValue.TryParse(contentType, out var ct)
            ? ct
            : new MediaTypeHeaderValue("application/octet-stream");
        form.Add(file, "filedata", fileName);

        var req = NewRequest(HttpMethod.Post, $"https://graph.facebook.com/{Version}/me/messages", token);
        req.Content = form;

        return await SendAndReadMessageIdAsync(req);
    }

    public async Task<(byte[] Content, string ContentType)?> DownloadAsync(string url)
    {
        try
        {
            using var res = await Http.GetAsync(url, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead);
            if (!res.IsSuccessStatusCode) return null;
            if (res.Content.Headers.ContentLength > MaxFileBytes) return null;

            var bytes = await res.Content.ReadAsByteArrayAsync();
            if (bytes.Length > MaxFileBytes) return null;

            return (bytes, res.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType ?? "application/octet-stream");
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static async Task<string?> SendAndReadMessageIdAsync(HttpRequestMessage req)
    {
        var res = await Http.SendAsync(req);
        var json = await res.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
        if (!res.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            var msg = doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("error", out var e) &&
                      e.TryGetProperty("message", out var m) ? m.GetString() : "Facebook rejected the message.";
            throw new UserFriendlyException("Facebook: " + msg);
        }

        return doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("message_id", out var mid) ? mid.GetString() : null;
    }
}

namespace CRM.Messenger;

public static class MessengerMime
{
    public static string TypeFromMime(string? mime)
    {
        mime = (mime ?? "").ToLowerInvariant();
        if (mime.StartsWith("image/")) return "image";
        if (mime.StartsWith("video/")) return "video";
        if (mime.StartsWith("audio/")) return "audio";
        return "file";
    }

    public static string ExtFromMime(string? mime) => (mime ?? "").ToLowerInvariant() switch
    {
        "image/jpeg" => ".jpg",
        "image/png" => ".png",
        "image/gif" => ".gif",
        "image/webp" => ".webp",
        "video/mp4" => ".mp4",
        "audio/mpeg" => ".mp3",
        "audio/mp4" => ".m4a",
        "audio/ogg" => ".ogg",
        "audio/aac" => ".aac",
        "application/pdf" => ".pdf",
        _ => ""
    };

    public static string Preview(string? type, string? name, string? text) => type switch
    {
        "image" => "📷 Photo",
        "video" => "🎥 Video",
        "audio" => "🎵 Audio",
        "file" => "📎 " + name,
        _ => text ?? ""
    };
}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Application\Messenger\MessengerWebhookProcessor.cs
=====================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;
using Volo.Abp.Domain.Repositories;
using Volo.Abp.Guids;
using Volo.Abp.MultiTenancy;

namespace CRM.Messenger;

public class MessengerWebhookProcessor : ITransientDependency
{
    private readonly IRepository<MessengerConversation, Guid> _conversations;
    private readonly IRepository<MessengerMessage, Guid> _messages;
    private readonly IGuidGenerator _guid;
    private readonly ICurrentTenant _currentTenant;
    private readonly MessengerGraphClient _graph;
    private readonly MessengerFileStore _files;
    private readonly MessengerConnectionService _connections;

    public MessengerWebhookProcessor(
        IRepository<MessengerConversation, Guid> conversations,
        IRepository<MessengerMessage, Guid> messages,
        IGuidGenerator guid,
        ICurrentTenant currentTenant,
        MessengerGraphClient graph,
        MessengerFileStore files,
        MessengerConnectionService connections)
    {
        _conversations = conversations;
        _messages = messages;
        _guid = guid;
        _currentTenant = currentTenant;
        _graph = graph;
        _files = files;
        _connections = connections;
    }

    public async Task ProcessAsync(string json)
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
        var root = doc.RootElement;

        if (!root.TryGetProperty("object", out var obj) || obj.GetString() != "page") return;
        if (!root.TryGetProperty("entry", out var entries)) return;

        foreach (var entry in entries.EnumerateArray())
        {
            if (!entry.TryGetProperty("id", out var idEl)) continue;
            var pageId = idEl.GetString();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageId)) continue;

            // Which tenant owns this page? (one indexed lookup)
            var conn = await _connections.FindByPageIdAsync(pageId);
            if (conn == null) continue;   // page not connected to any tenant: ignore

            if (!entry.TryGetProperty("messaging", out var events)) continue;

            // Everything below is saved under that tenant only
            using (_currentTenant.Change(conn.TenantId))
            {
                foreach (var evt in events.EnumerateArray())
                {
                    await ProcessEventAsync(evt, conn.PageId, conn.Token);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task ProcessEventAsync(JsonElement evt, string pageId, string token)
    {
        if (!evt.TryGetProperty("message", out var msg)) return;

        var isEcho = msg.TryGetProperty("is_echo", out var e) && e.GetBoolean();
        var senderId = evt.GetProperty("sender").GetProperty("id").GetString()!;
        var recipientId = evt.GetProperty("recipient").GetProperty("id").GetString()!;
        var psid = isEcho ? recipientId : senderId;

        var mid = msg.TryGetProperty("mid", out var m) ? m.GetString() : null;
        var time = evt.TryGetProperty("timestamp", out var ts)
            ? DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(ts.GetInt64()).UtcDateTime
            : DateTime.UtcNow;
        var text = msg.TryGetProperty("text", out var tx) ? tx.GetString() ?? "" : "";

        var items = new List<MessengerMessage>();

        // 1) Text part
        if (text.Length > 0 && !await ExistsAsync(mid))
        {
            items.Add(new MessengerMessage(_guid.Create(), Guid.Empty, mid, Trunc(text), !isEcho, time));
        }

        // 2) Attachments
        if (msg.TryGetProperty("attachments", out var atts) && atts.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
        {
            var i = 0;
            foreach (var a in atts.EnumerateArray())
            {
                var key = mid == null ? null : $"{mid}:{i}";
                i++;
                if (await ExistsAsync(key)) continue;

                var type = a.TryGetProperty("type", out var tp) ? tp.GetString() : null;
                var hasPayload = a.TryGetProperty("payload", out var pl) && pl.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object;
                var url = hasPayload && pl.TryGetProperty("url", out var u) && u.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
                    ? u.GetString() : null;
                var sentTime = time.AddMilliseconds(i);

                MessengerMessage? item;

                if ((type is "image" or "video" or "audio" or "file") && url != null)
                {
                    var dl = await _graph.DownloadAsync(url);
                    if (dl != null)
                    {
                        var (bytes, mime) = dl.Value;
                        var name = FileNameFrom(url, type!, mime);
                        var stored = await _files.SaveAsync(bytes, name);

                        item = new MessengerMessage(_guid.Create(), Guid.Empty, key, "", !isEcho, sentTime)
                        {
                            AttachmentType = type,
                            AttachmentName = name,
                            AttachmentMimeType = mime,
                            AttachmentStoredName = stored,
                            AttachmentSize = bytes.Length
                        };
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        item = new MessengerMessage(_guid.Create(), Guid.Empty, key,
                            $"[{type} unavailable]", !isEcho, sentTime);
                    }
                }
                else if (type == "location" && hasPayload &&
                         pl.TryGetProperty("coordinates", out var cc) &&
                         cc.TryGetProperty("lat", out var latEl) &&
                         cc.TryGetProperty("long", out var lngEl))
                {
                    var lat = latEl.GetDouble().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    var lng = lngEl.GetDouble().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    item = new MessengerMessage(_guid.Create(), Guid.Empty, key,
                        $"📍 https://www.google.com/maps?q={lat},{lng}", !isEcho, sentTime);
                }
                else if (url != null)
                {
                    var title = a.TryGetProperty("title", out var ttl) ? ttl.GetString() : null;
                    item = new MessengerMessage(_guid.Create(), Guid.Empty, key,
                        Trunc(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title) ? url : title + "\n" + url), !isEcho, sentTime);
                }
                else
                {
                    item = new MessengerMessage(_guid.Create(), Guid.Empty, key, "[Attachment]", !isEcho, sentTime);
                }

                items.Add(item);
            }
        }

        if (items.Count == 0 && text.Length == 0 && !await ExistsAsync(mid))
        {
            items.Add(new MessengerMessage(_guid.Create(), Guid.Empty, mid, "[Unsupported message]", !isEcho, time));
        }

        if (items.Count == 0) return;

        var conv = await _conversations.FindAsync(x => x.PageScopedUserId == psid);
        if (conv == null)
        {
            var (name, pic) = await _graph.GetProfileAsync(psid, token);
            conv = new MessengerConversation(_guid.Create(), psid, name, pic, pageId);
            await _conversations.InsertAsync(conv, autoSave: true);
        }
        else if (conv.PageId == null)
        {
            conv.PageId = pageId;   // fill old conversations automatically
        }

        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            item.ConversationId = conv.Id;
            await _messages.InsertAsync(item);
            if (!isEcho) conv.UnreadCount++;
        }

        var last = items[^1];
        var preview = MessengerMime.Preview(last.AttachmentType, last.AttachmentName, last.Text);
        conv.LastMessageText = preview.Length > 200 ? preview[..200] : preview;
        conv.LastMessageTime = time;
        await _conversations.UpdateAsync(conv, autoSave: true);
    }

    private async Task<bool> ExistsAsync(string? key)
        => key != null && await _messages.FindAsync(x => x.FacebookMessageId == key) != null;

    private static string Trunc(string s) => s.Length > 2000 ? s[..2000] : s;

    private static string FileNameFrom(string url, string type, string mime)
    {
        var name = "";
        try { name = Path.GetFileName(new Uri(url).AbsolutePath); } catch { }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) || !name.Contains('.'))
        {
            name = type + MessengerMime.ExtFromMime(mime);
        }

        return name.Length > 200 ? name[^200..] : name;
    }
}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Application\Sheets\SheetConnectionService.cs
=====================================================

using System;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Volo.Abp.Data;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;
using Volo.Abp.Domain.Repositories;
using Volo.Abp.Guids;
using Volo.Abp.MultiTenancy;
using Volo.Abp.Security.Encryption;

namespace CRM.Sheets;

public class SheetConnectionService : ITransientDependency
{
    private readonly IRepository<SheetConnection, Guid> _repo;
    private readonly IStringEncryptionService _crypto;
    private readonly IGuidGenerator _guid;
    private readonly ICurrentTenant _tenant;
    private readonly IDataFilter _filter;

    public SheetConnectionService(IRepository<SheetConnection, Guid> repo, IStringEncryptionService crypto,
        IGuidGenerator guid, ICurrentTenant tenant, IDataFilter filter)
    { _repo = repo; _crypto = crypto; _guid = guid; _tenant = tenant; _filter = filter; }

    private static string Rand(int bytes) => Convert.ToHexString(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(bytes)).ToLowerInvariant();

    // Current tenant's key/secret (tenant filter is automatic). Creates on first use.
    public async Task<(string Key, string Secret)> GetOrCreateAsync(bool regenerate = false)
    {
        var c = await (await _repo.GetQueryableAsync()).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        if (c == null)
        {
            var s = Rand(32);
            c = new SheetConnection(_guid.Create(), _tenant.Id, Rand(16), _crypto.Encrypt(s)!);
            await _repo.InsertAsync(c, autoSave: true);
            return (c.ConnectionKey, s);
        }
        if (regenerate)
        {
            c.Secret = _crypto.Encrypt(Rand(32))!;
            await _repo.UpdateAsync(c, autoSave: true);
        }
        return (c.ConnectionKey, _crypto.Decrypt(c.Secret)!);
    }

    // Webhook only (nobody logged in): find the owning tenant by key (unique index).
    public async Task<(Guid? TenantId, string Secret)?> FindAsync(string key)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) || key.Length > 64) return null;
        using (_filter.Disable<IMultiTenant>())
        {
            var c = await _repo.FindAsync(x => x.ConnectionKey == key);
            return c == null ? null : (c.TenantId, _crypto.Decrypt(c.Secret)!);
        }
    }
}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Application\Sheets\SheetLeadSyncService.cs
=====================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using CRM.CustomerTypes;
using CRM.Leads;
using CRM.LeadSources;
using CRM.LeadStages;
using CRM.Services;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;
using Volo.Abp.Domain.Entities;
using Volo.Abp.Domain.Repositories;
using Volo.Abp.Guids;
using Volo.Abp.Identity;
using Volo.Abp.ObjectMapping;

namespace CRM.Sheets;

public record NameId(Guid Id, string Name);

public class SheetRowDto
{
    public string ExternalId { get; set; } = "";
    public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    public string? CompanyName { get; set; }
    public string? Email { get; set; }
    public string? Phone { get; set; }
    public decimal? EstimatedBudget { get; set; }
    public string? Remarks { get; set; }
    public string? CustomerType { get; set; }
    public string? LeadSource { get; set; }
    public string? LeadStage { get; set; }
    public string? Service { get; set; }
    public string? AssignedUser { get; set; }
}

public class SheetPayload
{
    public long Ts { get; set; }
    public List<SheetRowDto> Rows { get; set; } = new();
}

public class SheetLeadSyncService : ITransientDependency
{
    private readonly IRepository<Lead, Guid> _leads;
    private readonly IRepository<CustomerType, Guid> _ct;
    private readonly IRepository<LeadSource, Guid> _ls;
    private readonly IRepository<LeadStage, Guid> _st;
    private readonly IRepository<Service, Guid> _sv;
    private readonly IRepository<IdentityUser, Guid> _users;
    private readonly IGuidGenerator _guid;
    private readonly IObjectMapper _mapper;

    public SheetLeadSyncService(IRepository<Lead, Guid> leads, IRepository<CustomerType, Guid> ct,
        IRepository<LeadSource, Guid> ls, IRepository<LeadStage, Guid> st, IRepository<Service, Guid> sv,
        IRepository<IdentityUser, Guid> users, IGuidGenerator guid, IObjectMapper mapper)
    { _leads = leads; _ct = ct; _ls = ls; _st = st; _sv = sv; _users = users; _guid = guid; _mapper = mapper; }

    private static string K(string? s) => s?.Trim() ?? "";

    private static async Task<Dictionary<string, Guid>> Names<T>(IRepository<T, Guid> repo, Expression<Func<T, NameId>> sel)
        where T : class, IEntity<Guid>
    {
        var list = await (await repo.GetQueryableAsync()).AsNoTracking().Select(sel).ToListAsync();
        var d = new Dictionary<string, Guid>(list.Count, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var x in list) d.TryAdd(x.Name.Trim(), x.Id);
        return d;
    }

    // Must run inside CurrentTenant.Change(...) -> tenant filter + TenantId are applied automatically.
    public async Task<(List<LeadDto> Changed, List<string> Errors)> SyncAsync(List<SheetRowDto> input)
    {
        var errors = new List<string>();
        var rows = input.Where(r => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.ExternalId) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.Name))
                        .GroupBy(r => r.ExternalId).Select(g => g.Last()).ToList();   // dedupe, last edit wins
        if (rows.Count == 0) return (new(), errors);

        var ids = rows.Select(r => r.ExternalId).ToList();
        var existing = (await _leads.GetListAsync(x => ids.Contains(x.ExternalId!)))
                       .ToDictionary(x => x.ExternalId!);

        var ct = await Names(_ct, x => new NameId(x.Id, x.Name));
        var ls = await Names(_ls, x => new NameId(x.Id, x.Name));
        var st = await Names(_st, x => new NameId(x.Id, x.Name));
        var sv = await Names(_sv, x => new NameId(x.Id, x.Name));

        var userNames = rows.Select(r => K(r.AssignedUser)).Where(n => n.Length > 0).Distinct().ToList();
        var users = new Dictionary<string, Guid>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (userNames.Count > 0)
        {
            var u = await (await _users.GetQueryableAsync()).AsNoTracking()
                .Where(x => userNames.Contains(x.UserName)).Select(x => new NameId(x.Id, x.UserName)).ToListAsync();
            foreach (var x in u) users.TryAdd(x.Name, x.Id);
        }

        var ins = new List<Lead>(); var upd = new List<Lead>(); var pairs = new List<(Lead, SheetRowDto)>(rows.Count);

        foreach (var r in rows)
        {
            if (!ct.TryGetValue(K(r.CustomerType), out var ctId) || !ls.TryGetValue(K(r.LeadSource), out var lsId) ||
                !st.TryGetValue(K(r.LeadStage), out var stId) || !sv.TryGetValue(K(r.Service), out var svId))
            {
                errors.Add($"{r.Name}: CustomerType/LeadSource/LeadStage/Service not found");
                continue;
            }
            Guid? uid = users.TryGetValue(K(r.AssignedUser), out var u1) ? u1 : null;

            if (existing.TryGetValue(r.ExternalId, out var l))
            {
                l.Name = K(r.Name); l.CompanyName = r.CompanyName ?? ""; l.Email = r.Email ?? ""; l.Phone = r.Phone ?? "";
                l.EstimatedBudget = r.EstimatedBudget ?? 0m; l.Remarks = r.Remarks;
                l.CustomerTypeId = ctId; l.LeadSourceId = lsId; l.LeadStageId = stId; l.ServiceId = svId; l.AssignedUserId = uid;
                upd.Add(l);
            }
            else
            {
                l = new Lead(_guid.Create(), K(r.Name), ctId, lsId, stId, svId, r.CompanyName ?? "", r.Email ?? "",
                    r.Phone ?? "", r.EstimatedBudget ?? 0m, r.Remarks, uid)
                { ExternalId = r.ExternalId };
                ins.Add(l);
            }
            pairs.Add((l, r));
        }

        if (ins.Count > 0) await _leads.InsertManyAsync(ins, autoSave: true);
        if (upd.Count > 0) await _leads.UpdateManyAsync(upd, autoSave: true);
        if (ins.Count + upd.Count > 0) await _leads.GetQueryableAsync(); // no-op; see note below

        var dtos = new List<LeadDto>(pairs.Count);
        foreach (var (l, r) in pairs)
        {
            var d = _mapper.Map<Lead, LeadDto>(l);
            d.CustomerTypeName = K(r.CustomerType); d.LeadSourceName = K(r.LeadSource);
            d.LeadStageName = K(r.LeadStage); d.ServiceName = K(r.Service);
            d.AssignedUserName = l.AssignedUserId.HasValue ? K(r.AssignedUser) : "Unassigned";
            dtos.Add(d);
        }
        return (dtos, errors);
    }
}

using System;
using Volo.Abp.Domain.Entities.Auditing;
using Volo.Abp.MultiTenancy;

namespace CRM.Leads;

public class Lead : FullAuditedAggregateRoot<Guid>, IMultiTenant
{
    public Guid? TenantId { get; set; }

    // Contact Information
    public string Name { get; set; } = default!;
    public string CompanyName { get; set; } = default!;
    public string Email { get; set; } = default!;
    public string Phone { get; set; } = default!;

    // Business Metadata & Deal Info
    public decimal EstimatedBudget { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ExpectedCloseDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime? NextFollowUpDate { get; set; }
    public string? Remarks { get; set; }

    // Dropdown Foreign Keys
    public Guid CustomerTypeId { get; set; }
    public Guid LeadSourceId { get; set; }
    public Guid LeadStageId { get; set; }
    public Guid ServiceId { get; set; }

    // Assigned User (ABP Identity User ID)
    public Guid? AssignedUserId { get; set; }
    public string? ExternalId { get; set; }   // sheet row key

    // Parameterless constructor required by ORM / ABP
    protected Lead()
    {
    }

    // Parameterized constructor including Id and all Lead attributes
    public Lead(
        Guid id,
        string name,
        Guid customerTypeId,
        Guid leadSourceId,
        Guid leadStageId,
        Guid serviceId,
        string companyName = "",
        string email = "",
        string phone = "",
        decimal estimatedBudget = 0m,
        string? remarks = null,
        Guid? assignedUserId = null,
        DateTime? expectedCloseDate = null,
        DateTime? nextFollowUpDate = null,
        string? externalId = null)
        : base(id)
    {
        Name = name;
        CustomerTypeId = customerTypeId;
        LeadSourceId = leadSourceId;
        LeadStageId = leadStageId;
        ServiceId = serviceId;
        CompanyName = companyName;
        Email = email;
        Phone = phone;
        EstimatedBudget = estimatedBudget;
        Remarks = remarks;
        AssignedUserId = assignedUserId;
        ExpectedCloseDate = expectedCloseDate;
        NextFollowUpDate = nextFollowUpDate;
        ExternalId = externalId;
    }
}

namespace CRM.Messenger;

    public Guid? TenantId { get; set; }

    public string Text { get; set; } = default!;

    public DateTime SentTime { get; set; }

    public string? AttachmentMimeType { get; set; }
    public string? AttachmentStoredName { get; set; }  // file name on the server disk
    public long? AttachmentSize { get; set; }

    protected MessengerMessage() { }

    public MessengerMessage(Guid id, Guid conversationId, string? fbMid, string text,
        bool fromCustomer, DateTime sentTime, Guid? sentByUserId = null) : base(id)
    {
        ConversationId = conversationId;
        FacebookMessageId = fbMid;
        Text = text;
        IsFromCustomer = fromCustomer;
        SentTime = sentTime;
        SentByUserId = sentByUserId;
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Volo.Abp.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Volo.Abp.Modularity;
using CRM;

namespace CRM.EntityFrameworkCore;

[DependsOn(
    typeof(CRMDomainModule),
    typeof(AbpEntityFrameworkCoreModule)
)]
public class CRMEntityFrameworkCoreModule : AbpModule
{
    public override void ConfigureServices(ServiceConfigurationContext context)
    {
        context.Services.AddAbpDbContext<CRMDbContext>(options =>
        {
            options.AddDefaultRepositories(includeAllEntities: true);
        });
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using Volo.Abp.EntityFrameworkCore.Modeling;

namespace CRM.CustomerTypes;

public class CustomerTypeConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<CustomerType>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<CustomerType> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("CustomerTypes");
        builder.ConfigureByConvention(); // Automatically configures IMultiTenant properties

        builder.Property(x => x.Name).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(128);
        builder.Property(x => x.Description).HasMaxLength(512);

        // Index for multi-tenant lookups
        builder.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Name });
    }
}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.EntityFrameworkCore\EntityFrameworkCore\CRMDbContext.cs
=====================================================

using CRM.CustomerTypes;
using CRM.Leads;
using CRM.LeadSources;
using CRM.LeadStages;
using CRM.Messenger;
using CRM.SalesPipelines;
using CRM.Services;
using CRM.Sheets;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Volo.Abp.Data;
using Volo.Abp.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace CRM.EntityFrameworkCore;

[ConnectionStringName("Default")]
public class CRMDbContext : AbpDbContext<CRMDbContext>
{
    public DbSet<LeadSource> LeadSources { get; set; }
    public DbSet<CustomerType> CustomerTypes { get; set; }
    public DbSet<SalesPipeline> SalesPipelines { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Service> Services { get; set; }
    public DbSet<LeadStage> LeadStages { get; set; }
    public DbSet<Lead> Leads { get; set; }

    public DbSet<MessengerConversation> MessengerConversations { get; set; }
    public DbSet<MessengerMessage> MessengerMessages { get; set; }
    public DbSet<MessengerPageConnection> MessengerPageConnections { get; set; }
    public DbSet<SheetConnection> SheetConnections { get; set; }

    public CRMDbContext(DbContextOptions<CRMDbContext> options)
        : base(options)
    {
    }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);
        builder.ConfigureCRM();
    }
}


=====================================================
FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.EntityFrameworkCore\EntityFrameworkCore\CRMDbContextModelCreatingExtensions.cs
=====================================================

using CRM.CustomerTypes;
using CRM.Leads;
using CRM.LeadSources;
using CRM.LeadStages;
using CRM.Messenger;
using CRM.SalesPipelines;
using CRM.Services;
using CRM.Sheets;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Volo.Abp;
using Volo.Abp.EntityFrameworkCore.Modeling;

namespace CRM.EntityFrameworkCore;

public static class CRMDbContextModelCreatingExtensions
{
    public static void ConfigureCRM(this ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        Check.NotNull(builder, nameof(builder));

        builder.Entity<LeadSource>(b =>
        {
            b.ToTable("CrmLeadSources");
            b.ConfigureByConvention();

            b.Property(x => x.Name).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(128);
            b.Property(x => x.Description).HasMaxLength(512);
        });

        builder.Entity<CustomerType>(b =>
        {
            b.ToTable("CrmCustomerTypes");
            b.ConfigureByConvention();

            b.Property(x => x.Name).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(128);
            b.Property(x => x.Description).HasMaxLength(512);

            b.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Name });
        });

        builder.Entity<Lead>(b =>
        {
            b.ToTable("CrmLeads");
            b.ConfigureByConvention();

            b.Property(x => x.Name).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(128);
            b.Property(x => x.CompanyName).HasMaxLength(128);
            b.Property(x => x.Email).HasMaxLength(256);
            b.Property(x => x.Phone).HasMaxLength(32);
            b.Property(x => x.EstimatedBudget).HasColumnType("decimal(18,2)");
            b.Property(x => x.Remarks).HasMaxLength(1000);

            b.Property(x => x.ExternalId).HasMaxLength(64);
            b.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ExternalId });

            // Foreign Key Relations
            b.HasOne<CustomerType>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(x => x.CustomerTypeId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            b.HasOne<LeadSource>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(x => x.LeadSourceId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            b.HasOne<LeadStage>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(x => x.LeadStageId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            b.HasOne<Service>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(x => x.ServiceId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        builder.Entity<SheetConnection>(b =>
        {
            b.ToTable("CrmSheetConnections");
            b.ConfigureByConvention();
            b.Property(x => x.ConnectionKey).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(64);
            b.Property(x => x.Secret).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(512);
            b.HasIndex(x => x.ConnectionKey).IsUnique();
        });

        builder.ApplyConfiguration(new SalesPipelineConfiguration());
        builder.ApplyConfiguration(new LeadStageConfiguration());

        // Messenger

        builder.Entity<MessengerConversation>(b =>
        {
            b.ToTable("CrmMessengerConversations");
            b.ConfigureByConvention();
            b.Property(x => x.PageScopedUserId).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(128);
            b.Property(x => x.CustomerName).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(256);
            b.Property(x => x.ProfilePictureUrl).HasMaxLength(1024);
            b.Property(x => x.LastMessageText).HasMaxLength(1000);
            b.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.PageScopedUserId }).IsUnique();
            b.Property(x => x.PageId).HasMaxLength(64);
        });

        builder.Entity<MessengerMessage>(b =>
        {
            b.ToTable("CrmMessengerMessages");
            b.ConfigureByConvention();
            b.Property(x => x.FacebookMessageId).HasMaxLength(256);
            b.Property(x => x.Text).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(2000);
            b.HasIndex(x => new { x.ConversationId, x.SentTime });
            b.HasIndex(x => x.FacebookMessageId);

            b.Property(x => x.AttachmentType).HasMaxLength(32);
            b.Property(x => x.AttachmentName).HasMaxLength(256);
            b.Property(x => x.AttachmentMimeType).HasMaxLength(128);
            b.Property(x => x.AttachmentStoredName).HasMaxLength(128);

            b.HasOne<MessengerConversation>().WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(x => x.ConversationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });
        builder.Entity<MessengerPageConnection>(b =>
        {
            b.ToTable("CrmMessengerPageConnections");
            b.ConfigureByConvention();
            b.Property(x => x.PageId).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(64);
            b.Property(x => x.PageName).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(256);
            b.Property(x => x.AccessToken).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(1024);
            b.HasIndex(x => x.PageId).IsUnique();   // one page belongs to exactly one tenant
        });

    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using Volo.Abp.EntityFrameworkCore.Modeling;

namespace CRM.SalesPipelines;

public class SalesPipelineConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<SalesPipeline>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<SalesPipeline> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("CRMSalesPipelines");
        builder.ConfigureByConvention();

        builder.Property(x => x.Name)
            .IsRequired()
            .HasMaxLength(128);

        builder.Property(x => x.Description)
            .HasMaxLength(512);

        builder.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Name });
    }
}

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.UI.Navigation;

namespace CRM.Web.Menus;

public class CRMMenuContributor : IMenuContributor
{
    public async Task ConfigureMenuAsync(MenuConfigurationContext context)
    {
        if (context.Menu.Name == StandardMenus.Main)
        {
            await ConfigureMainMenuAsync(context);
        }
    }

    private Task ConfigureMainMenuAsync(MenuConfigurationContext context)
    {
        var crmMenu = new ApplicationMenuItem(
            CRMMenus.GroupName,
            "CRM",
            icon: "fa fa-users"
        );

        crmMenu.AddItem(new ApplicationMenuItem(
            CRMMenus.LeadSources,
            "Lead Sources",
            url: "/LeadSources",
            icon: "fa fa-list"
        ));

        crmMenu.AddItem(new ApplicationMenuItem(
            CRMMenus.CustomerTypes,
            "Customer Types",
            url: "/CustomerTypes",
            icon: "fa fa-id-card"
        ));
        crmMenu.AddItem(new ApplicationMenuItem(
            CRMMenus.SalesPipelines,
            "Sales Pipelines",
            url: "/SalesPipelines",
            icon: "fa fa-filter"
        ));
        crmMenu.AddItem(new ApplicationMenuItem(
            CRMMenus.Services,
            "Services",
            url: "/Services",
            icon: "fa fa-concierge-bell"
        ));
        crmMenu.AddItem(new ApplicationMenuItem(
            CRMMenus.LeadStages,
            "Lead Stages",
            url: "/LeadStages",
            icon: "fa fa-layer-group"
        ));

        crmMenu.AddItem(new ApplicationMenuItem(
            CRMMenus.Leads,
            "Leads",
            url: "/Leads",
            icon: "fa fa-user-tie"
        ));

        crmMenu.AddItem(new ApplicationMenuItem(
            CRMMenus.Settings,
            "Settings",
            url: "/Messenger/Settings",
            icon: "fa fa-user-tie"
        ));
        crmMenu.AddItem(new ApplicationMenuItem(
            CRMMenus.SheetSettings,
            "Google Sheets",
            url: "/Sheets/Settings",
            icon: "fa-brands fa-google-drive"
        ));

        context.Menu.AddItem(crmMenu);

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Web\Pages\CustomerTypes\Index.cshtml.cs

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using CRM.CustomerTypes;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Volo.Abp.Application.Dtos;
using Volo.Abp.AspNetCore.Mvc.UI.RazorPages;

namespace CRM.Web.Pages.CustomerTypes;

public class IndexModel : AbpPageModel
{
    private readonly ICustomerTypeAppService _customerTypeAppService;

    public IndexModel(ICustomerTypeAppService customerTypeAppService)
    {
        _customerTypeAppService = customerTypeAppService;
    }

    public void OnGet()
    {
    }

    // =========================================================
    // LIST
    // =========================================================

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnGetListAsync(
        int draw = 1,
        int start = 0,
        int length = 10,
        string? sorting = null)
    {
        var result = await _customerTypeAppService.GetListAsync(
            new PagedAndSortedResultRequestDto
            {
                SkipCount = start,
                MaxResultCount = length,
                Sorting = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sorting) ? "Name" : sorting
            });

        return new JsonResult(new
        {
            draw = draw,
            recordsTotal = result.TotalCount,
            recordsFiltered = result.TotalCount,
            data = result.Items
        });
    }

    // =========================================================
    // CREATE
    // =========================================================

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostCreateAsync(CreateUpdateCustomerTypeDto input)
    {
        if (!ModelState.IsValid)
        {
            return new JsonResult(new
            {
                success = false,
                message = "Invalid data."
            });
        }

        await _customerTypeAppService.CreateAsync(input);

        return new JsonResult(new
        {
            success = true
        });
    }

    // =========================================================
    // UPDATE
    // =========================================================

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostUpdateAsync(Guid id, CreateUpdateCustomerTypeDto input)
    {
        if (!ModelState.IsValid)
        {
            return new JsonResult(new
            {
                success = false,
                message = "Invalid data."
            });
        }

        await _customerTypeAppService.UpdateAsync(id, input);

        return new JsonResult(new
        {
            success = true,
            message = "Customer Type updated successfully."
        });
    }

    // =========================================================
    // DELETE
    // =========================================================

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostDeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        await _customerTypeAppService.DeleteAsync(id);

        return new JsonResult(new
        {
            success = true
        });
    }
}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Web\Pages\Leads\Index.cshtml.cs
=====================================================

using CRM.CustomerTypes;
using CRM.Leads;
using CRM.LeadSources;
using CRM.LeadStages;
using CRM.Services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Rendering;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.Application.Dtos;
using Volo.Abp.AspNetCore.Mvc.UI.RazorPages;
using Volo.Abp.Identity;

namespace CRM.Web.Pages.Leads;

public class IndexModel : AbpPageModel
{
    private readonly ILeadAppService _leadAppService;
    private readonly ICustomerTypeAppService _customerTypeAppService;
    private readonly ILeadSourceAppService _leadSourceAppService;
    private readonly ILeadStageAppService _leadStageAppService;
    private readonly IServiceAppService _serviceAppService;
    private readonly IIdentityUserAppService _identityUserAppService;

    public List<SelectListItem> CustomerTypes { get; set; } = new();
    public List<SelectListItem> LeadSources { get; set; } = new();
    public List<SelectListItem> LeadStages { get; set; } = new();
    public List<SelectListItem> Services { get; set; } = new();
    public List<SelectListItem> Users { get; set; } = new();

    public IndexModel(
        ILeadAppService leadAppService,
        ICustomerTypeAppService customerTypeAppService,
        ILeadSourceAppService leadSourceAppService,
        ILeadStageAppService leadStageAppService,
        IServiceAppService serviceAppService,
        IIdentityUserAppService identityUserAppService)
    {
        _leadAppService = leadAppService;
        _customerTypeAppService = customerTypeAppService;
        _leadSourceAppService = leadSourceAppService;
        _leadStageAppService = leadStageAppService;
        _serviceAppService = serviceAppService;
        _identityUserAppService = identityUserAppService;
    }

    public async Task OnGetAsync()
    {
        var ctList = await _customerTypeAppService.GetListAsync(new PagedAndSortedResultRequestDto { MaxResultCount = 1000 });
        CustomerTypes = ctList.Items.Select(x => new SelectListItem(x.Name, x.Id.ToString())).ToList();

        var lsList = await _leadSourceAppService.GetListAsync(new PagedAndSortedResultRequestDto { MaxResultCount = 1000 });
        LeadSources = lsList.Items.Select(x => new SelectListItem(x.Name, x.Id.ToString())).ToList();

        var stageList = await _leadStageAppService.GetListAsync(new PagedAndSortedResultRequestDto { MaxResultCount = 1000 });
        LeadStages = stageList.Items.Select(x => new SelectListItem(x.Name, x.Id.ToString())).ToList();

        var serviceList = await _serviceAppService.GetListAsync(new PagedAndSortedResultRequestDto { MaxResultCount = 1000 });
        Services = serviceList.Items.Select(x => new SelectListItem(x.Name, x.Id.ToString())).ToList();

        // Get Users from ABP Identity Module
        var userList = await _identityUserAppService.GetListAsync(new GetIdentityUsersInput { MaxResultCount = 1000 });
        Users = userList.Items.Select(x => new SelectListItem($"{x.UserName} ({x.Email})", x.Id.ToString())).ToList();
    }

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnGetListAsync(int draw = 1, int start = 0, int length = 10, string? sorting = null)
    {
        var result = await _leadAppService.GetListAsync(new PagedAndSortedResultRequestDto
        {
            SkipCount = start,
            MaxResultCount = length,
            Sorting = sorting
        });

        return new JsonResult(new
        {
            draw = draw,
            recordsTotal = result.TotalCount,
            recordsFiltered = result.TotalCount,
            data = result.Items
        });
    }

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostCreateAsync(CreateUpdateLeadDto input)
    {
        if (!ModelState.IsValid) return new JsonResult(new { success = false, message = "Invalid Form Input" });
        await _leadAppService.CreateAsync(input);
        return new JsonResult(new { success = true, message = "Lead created successfully!" });
    }

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostUpdateAsync(Guid id, CreateUpdateLeadDto input)
    {
        if (!ModelState.IsValid) return new JsonResult(new { success = false, message = "Invalid Form Input" });
        await _leadAppService.UpdateAsync(id, input);
        return new JsonResult(new { success = true, message = "Lead updated successfully!" });
    }

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostDeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        await _leadAppService.DeleteAsync(id);
        return new JsonResult(new { success = true, message = "Lead deleted successfully!" });
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostUploadCsvAsync(IFormFile csvFile)
    {
        if (!Path.GetExtension(csvFile.FileName).Equals(".csv", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return new JsonResult(new { success = false, message = "Only .csv files are allowed." });
        }
        if (csvFile == null || csvFile.Length == 0)
        {
            return new JsonResult(new { success = false, message = "Please select a valid CSV file." });
        }

        try
        {
            string csvContent;
            using (var reader = new StreamReader(csvFile.OpenReadStream()))
            {
                csvContent = await reader.ReadToEndAsync();
            }

            var importedCount = await _leadAppService.ImportCsvAsync(csvContent);

            return new JsonResult(new
            {
                success = true,
                message = $"Successfully imported {importedCount} leads!"
            });
        }
        catch (System.Exception ex)
        {
            var message = ex.InnerException != null ? ex.InnerException.Message : ex.Message;
            return new JsonResult(new { success = false, message });
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using CRM.LeadSources;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Volo.Abp.Application.Dtos;
using Volo.Abp.AspNetCore.Mvc.UI.RazorPages;

namespace CRM.Web.Pages.LeadSources;

public class IndexModel : AbpPageModel
{
    private readonly ILeadSourceAppService _leadSourceAppService;

    public IndexModel(
        ILeadSourceAppService leadSourceAppService)
    {
        _leadSourceAppService = leadSourceAppService;
    }

    public void OnGet()
    {
    }


    // =========================================================
    // LIST
    // =========================================================

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnGetListAsync(
        int draw = 1,
        int start = 0,
        int length = 10,
        string? sorting = null)
    {
        var result = await _leadSourceAppService.GetListAsync(
            new PagedAndSortedResultRequestDto
            {
                SkipCount = start,
                MaxResultCount = length,
                Sorting = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sorting)
                    ? "Name"
                    : sorting
            });

        return new JsonResult(new
        {
            draw = draw,
            recordsTotal = result.TotalCount,
            recordsFiltered = result.TotalCount,
            data = result.Items
        });
    }


    // =========================================================
    // CREATE
    // =========================================================

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostCreateAsync(
        CreateUpdateLeadSourceDto input)
    {
        if (!ModelState.IsValid)
        {
            return new JsonResult(new
            {
                success = false,
                message = "Invalid data."
            });
        }

        await _leadSourceAppService.CreateAsync(input);

        return new JsonResult(new
        {
            success = true
        });
    }


    // =========================================================
    // DELETE
    // =========================================================

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostDeleteAsync(
        Guid id)
    {
        await _leadSourceAppService.DeleteAsync(id);

        return new JsonResult(new
        {
            success = true
        });
    }

    // =========================================================
    // UPDATE
    // =========================================================

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostUpdateAsync(
        Guid id,
        CreateUpdateLeadSourceDto input)
    {
        if (!ModelState.IsValid)
        {
            return new JsonResult(new
            {
                success = false,
                message = "Invalid data."
            });
        }

        await _leadSourceAppService.UpdateAsync(id, input);

        return new JsonResult(new
        {
            success = true,
            message = "Lead Source updated successfully."
        });
    }


}

FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Web\Pages\Messenger\Index.cshtml.cs

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using CRM.Messenger;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Volo.Abp.AspNetCore.Mvc.UI.RazorPages;

namespace CRM.Web.Pages.Messenger;

[Authorize]
public class IndexModel : AbpPageModel
{
    private readonly IMessengerAppService _service;

    public IndexModel(IMessengerAppService service)
    {
        _service = service;
    }

    public IActionResult OnGet() => Redirect("/");

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnGetConversationsAsync()
        => new JsonResult(await _service.GetConversationsAsync());

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnGetMessagesAsync(Guid id)
        => new JsonResult(await _service.GetMessagesAsync(id));

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnGetUnreadAsync()
        => new JsonResult(new { count = await _service.GetUnreadCountAsync() });

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostSendAsync(Guid id, [FromBody] SendMessengerMessageInput input)
        => new JsonResult(await _service.SendAsync(id, input));

    // POST /Messenger?handler=SendFile&id=...   (multipart, field name "file")
    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostSendFileAsync(Guid id, IFormFile? file)
    {
        if (file == null || file.Length == 0)
        {
            return new JsonResult(new { success = false, message = "No file selected." });
        }

        using var ms = new MemoryStream();
        await file.CopyToAsync(ms);

        return new JsonResult(await _service.SendFileAsync(id, file.FileName, file.ContentType, ms.ToArray()));
    }

    // GET /Messenger?handler=File&id=<messageId>&download=true
    public async Task<IActionResult> OnGetFileAsync(Guid id, bool download = false)
    {
        var f = await _service.GetAttachmentAsync(id);
        var type = (f.ContentType ?? "").ToLowerInvariant();

        // Only safe media types are shown inline. Everything else is downloaded,
        // so an uploaded .html/.svg can never run inside your app.
        var inlineOk = !download &&
            ((type.StartsWith("image/") && !type.Contains("svg")) ||
             type.StartsWith("video/") || type.StartsWith("audio/"));

        if (inlineOk)
        {
            return new FileContentResult(f.Content, f.ContentType!)
            {
                EnableRangeProcessing = true
            };
        }

        return File(f.Content, "application/octet-stream", f.FileName);
    }

    public async Task<JsonResult> OnPostReadAsync(Guid id)
    {
        await _service.MarkAsReadAsync(id);
        return new JsonResult(new { success = true });
    }
}

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using CRM.Messenger;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Volo.Abp;
using Volo.Abp.AspNetCore.Mvc.UI.RazorPages;

namespace CRM.Web.Pages.Messenger;

[Authorize]
public class SettingsModel : AbpPageModel
{
    private readonly MessengerConnectionService _connections;

    public SettingsModel(MessengerConnectionService connections)
    {
        _connections = connections;
    }

    public string? PageName { get; set; }
    public string? Error { get; set; }

    [BindProperty]
    public string Token { get; set; } = "";

    public async Task OnGetAsync()
    {
        PageName = (await _connections.GetCurrentAsync())?.PageName;
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostConnectAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            await _connections.ConnectAsync(Token);
            return RedirectToPage();
        }
        catch (UserFriendlyException ex)
        {
            Error = ex.Message;
            PageName = (await _connections.GetCurrentAsync())?.PageName;
            return Page();
        }
    }

    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostDisconnectAsync()
    {
        await _connections.DisconnectAsync();
        return RedirectToPage();
    }
}

=====================================================
FILE: modules\CRM\src\CRM.Web\Pages\Messenger\Webhook.cshtml.cs
=====================================================

using CRM.Messenger;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.AspNetCore.Mvc.UI.RazorPages;
using Volo.Abp.Auditing;

namespace CRM.Web.Pages.Messenger;

[AllowAnonymous]
[IgnoreAntiforgeryToken]
[DisableAuditing]
public class WebhookModel : AbpPageModel
{
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;
    private readonly MessengerWebhookProcessor _processor;

    public WebhookModel(IConfiguration config, MessengerWebhookProcessor processor)
    {
        _config = config;
        _processor = processor;
    }

    // Facebook calls this once when you save the webhook in the Meta dashboard.
    public IActionResult OnGet(
        [FromQuery(Name = "hub.mode")] string? mode,
        [FromQuery(Name = "hub.verify_token")] string? token,
        [FromQuery(Name = "hub.challenge")] string? challenge)
    {

        if (mode == "subscribe" && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(token) && token == _config["Messenger:VerifyToken"])
        {
            return Content(challenge ?? "", "text/plain");
        }

        return StatusCode(403);
    }

    // Facebook sends every new message here.
    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostAsync()
    {
        using var ms = new MemoryStream();
        await Request.Body.CopyToAsync(ms);
        var raw = ms.ToArray();

        Logger.LogInformation("Messenger webhook received: {Bytes} bytes", raw.Length);

        var secret = _config["Messenger:AppSecret"];
        var header = Request.Headers["X-Hub-Signature-256"].ToString();

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(secret) || !IsValidSignature(raw, secret, header))
        {
            Logger.LogWarning("Messenger webhook REJECTED: invalid signature. Check Messenger:AppSecret.");
            return StatusCode(403);
        }

        try
        {
            var body = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(raw);
            Logger.LogInformation("Messenger payload: {Body}", body);
            await _processor.ProcessAsync(body);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Messenger webhook processing FAILED");
            throw;
        }

        return new OkResult();
    }

    private static bool IsValidSignature(byte[] body, string secret, string header)
    {
        if (!header.StartsWith("sha256=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return false;

        using var hmac = new HMACSHA256(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secret));
        var expected = "sha256=" + Convert.ToHexString(hmac.ComputeHash(body)).ToLowerInvariant();

        return CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(
            Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(expected),
            Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(header.ToLowerInvariant()));
    }
}
